name: Performance Audit
description: Audit Three.js and React performance when 3D components are modified

actions.prompt:
Review the 3D visualization code for performance optimization opportunities:
1. Three.js rendering efficiency
2. React re-render optimization
3. Memory usage patterns
4. Animation performance
5. LOD implementation
6. Instancing usage
7. Frustum culling
8. Frame rate optimization
